title: Mechanical Symptoms
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask whether anything in the knee clicks, catches or grinds, and then ask whether it hurts when it does.
Ask whether it happens in a particular position, because reproducibility at a specific angle suggests a structural cause.
Ask whether anything ever stops the knee moving, which is the locking question.
Ask whether they can make it happen on request, since a patient who can demonstrate it gives you an examination finding rather than a history.
